detail.text: I need to read the repository structure and AGENTS.md carefully, then create a plan for building this link shortener application.
Now I have a good understanding of the repository structure. Let me check if there's an acceptance directory already:

Now I have a complete picture. Let me create the plan for building this link shortener application.

The spec requires:
1. **Foundation**: Schema, store interface, server setup with auth middleware, one e2e test
2. **Auth endpoints**: signup, login, logout, /api/me with sessions and rate limiting
3. **Links CRUD**: create, list, delete links with slug generation and validation
4. **Redirect & stats**: GET /<slug> redirect with click counting, stats endpoint
5. **QR code**: PNG generation endpoint
6. **Frontend pages**: signup, login, my links, link detail with stats chart and QR
7. **Integration**: All acceptance tests A1-A9

Let me structure this into cards:

```json
{
  "summary": "Build a link shortener with Go API and React frontend. Foundation card establishes SQLite schema, store interface, auth middleware, and server constructor. Feature cards add auth endpoints, links CRUD, redirect/stats, QR code, and frontend pages in parallel. Integration card implements all acceptance tests A1-A9.",
  "cards": [
    {
      "key": "foundation",
      "role": "foundation",
      "title": "Schema, store interface, auth middleware, server constructor",
      "brief": "Establish the app's foundation:\n\n- Create `internal/store/store.go` with `Store` interface: user CRUD (CreateUser, GetUserByEmail, GetUserByID), link CRUD (CreateLink, GetLinkBySlug, ListLinksByUser, DeleteLink, IncrementClick), stats (GetClickStats), session management.\n- Create `internal/store/sqlite.go` implementing Store using modernc.org/sqlite, opening `$DATA_DIR/links.db`.\n- Create migration `migrations/20250101000000_initial.sql` with users, links, clicks tables.\n- Create `internal/server/auth.go` with `UserFromContext(r)` helper and session cookie middleware (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax).\n- Extend `server.New` to accept Store, register routes from `routes_*.go` files.\n- Add one end-to-end test in `internal/server/server_test.go` verifying healthz and that unauthenticated /api/me returns 401.\n\nContracts every card builds on:\n- Auth: `server.UserFromContext(r *http.Request) (userID int64, ok bool)` in package `internal/server`.\n- Store: `store.Store` interface in `internal/store`, implementation in same package via `store.Open(dataDir string) (*SQLiteStore, error)`.\n- Server: `server.New(server.Config{DataDir: string, Store: store.Store}) http.Handler`.",
      "directories": ["internal/store", "internal/server", "migrations"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestServerHealthz in internal/server: GET /healthz returns 200 with status ok", "TestServerUnauthMe in internal/server: GET /api/me without session returns 401"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "auth",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Auth endpoints: signup, login, logout, me with rate limiting",
      "brief": "Implement authentication endpoints in `internal/server/routes_auth.go`:\n\n- POST /api/signup: validate email format, password >= 10 chars, bcrypt hash, create user, set session cookie, return user JSON.\n- POST /api/login: validate credentials, set session cookie, return user JSON.\n- POST /api/logout: clear session cookie.\n- GET /api/me: return current user from session or 401.\n- Rate limit: max 10 signup/login attempts per minute per client IP, return 429 when exceeded. Use in-memory map with mutex.\n- Session stored in DB (sessions table added via migration), cookie contains session token.\n\nAdd unit tests in `internal/server/routes_auth_test.go` covering signup, login, logout, me, invalid inputs, and rate limiting (11th attempt returns 429).",
      "directories": ["internal/server", "migrations"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestSignup in internal/server: valid signup returns 200 with user, sets cookie", "TestLogin in internal/server: valid login returns 200, sets cookie", "TestLogout in internal/server: clears cookie, subsequent /api/me returns 401", "TestRateLimitAuth in internal/server: 11th login attempt in a minute returns 429"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "links",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Links CRUD: create, list, delete with slug validation",
      "brief": "Implement link management in `internal/server/routes_links.go`:\n\n- POST /api/links: body has url (required, http/https only, max 2048 chars) and optional slug ([a-z0-9-]{3,32}). If no slug, generate 7 random chars. Check slug uniqueness, return 409 if taken. Rate limit: 30 new links per hour per user, 429 when exceeded.\n- GET /api/links: return list of current user's links with click counts.\n- DELETE /api/links/<slug>: delete only own link, return 404 if not found or not owned.\n\nAdd unit tests covering: create with auto slug, create with custom slug, duplicate slug 409, invalid URL scheme 400, URL too long 400, list returns own links only, delete own vs other's link.",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestCreateLink in internal/server: POST /api/links with valid URL returns 201 with slug", "TestCreateLinkDuplicateSlug in internal/server: duplicate custom slug returns 409", "TestCreateLinkInvalidScheme in internal/server: ftp:// URL returns 400", "TestListLinks in internal/server: GET /api/links returns user's links with click counts", "TestDeleteLinkOwn in internal/server: DELETE own link returns 204", "TestDeleteLinkOther in internal/server: DELETE other user's link returns 404"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "redirect-stats",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Redirect endpoint and per-day click stats",
      "brief": "Implement redirect and stats in `internal/server/routes_redirect.go`:\n\n- GET /<slug>: look up link, increment total click count and per-UTC-day count, respond 302 with Location header. Unknown slug returns 404. This route must not conflict with /api/, /app/, /healthz.\n- GET /api/links/<slug>/stats: return JSON array of 30 entries (last 30 UTC days), each with date and count. Requires auth; return 404 if link not owned by user.\n\nClicks stored in clicks table (link_id, date TEXT as YYYY-MM-DD, count INT). Increment is atomic (INSERT OR UPDATE).\n\nAdd unit tests: redirect increments count, unknown slug 404, stats returns 30 days with correct counts.",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestRedirect in internal/server: GET /<slug> returns 302 with correct Location", "TestRedirectUnknown in internal/server: GET /unknown returns 404", "TestStats in internal/server: GET /api/links/<slug>/stats returns 30 days array", "TestStatsAfterClicks in internal/server: after 2 redirects, today's count is 2"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "qr",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "QR code PNG endpoint for short URLs",
      "brief": "Implement QR code generation in `internal/server/routes_qr.go`:\n\n- GET /api/links/<slug>/qr: generate QR code PNG of the full short URL (scheme + host from request + /<slug>). Return image/png content type. Requires auth; return 404 if link not owned.\n- Use a pure-Go QR library (e.g., github.com/skip2/go-qrcode).\n\nAdd unit tests: endpoint returns 200 with Content-Type image/png, body is valid PNG (starts with PNG signature), decodable QR.",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestQRCode in internal/server: GET /api/links/<slug>/qr returns 200 image/png", "TestQRCodePNG in internal/server: response body starts with PNG signature bytes"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "frontend",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "React SPA: signup, login, my links, link detail pages",
      "brief": "Build the single-page app under web/src/:\n\n- Pages: SignUp (/signup), Login (/login), MyLinks (/links) with create form, list with click counts, copy button, delete button. LinkDetail (/links/:slug) with bar chart of 30-day stats and QR code image. NotFound catch-all.\n- Auth state via /api/me on mount; redirect to /login if unauthenticated on protected pages.\n- Use react-router (already installed). Routes exported from App.tsx.\n- Tests using renderAt and mockFetch from src/test/: each page renders, forms submit, API calls mocked.\n- TypeScript types for API responses.\n\nRun npm run lint and npm test to verify.",
      "directories": ["web/src"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestSignUpPage in web/src: renders signup form with email and password fields", "TestLoginPage in web/src: renders login form", "TestMyLinksPage in web/src: renders create form and link list", "TestLinkDetailPage in web/src: renders stats chart and QR image", "TestNotFoundPage in web/src: renders not found message"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "integration",
      "role": "integration",
      "title": "Acceptance tests A1-A9 against httptest server",
      "brief": "Implement all acceptance tests in `acceptance/acceptance_test.go` using httptest and server.New:\n\n- A1: TestAuthFlow - sign up, log in, GET /api/me returns user; log out, /api/me returns 401.\n- A2: TestRedirectAndCount - create link, GET /<slug> returns 302 with Location; list shows 1 click.\n- A3: TestSlugConflictAndValidation - duplicate custom slug returns 409; ftp:// URL returns 400.\n- A4: TestCrossUserDelete - second user deleting first user's link returns 404; link still redirects.\n- A5: TestStatsThirtyDays - stats returns 30 entries, today's count is 2 after two redirects.\n- A6: TestQRCodePNG - QR endpoint returns image/png, body is decodable PNG.\n- A7: TestRateLimitLogin - 11th login attempt within a minute returns 429.\n- A8: TestSPAIndex - GET /app/ and GET /app/links/abc return index with <div id=\"root\">.\n- A9: TestUnknownSlug404 - GET /nope123 returns 404.\n\nAll tests use fresh server per test or subtest, temp DataDir.",
      "directories": ["acceptance"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestAuthFlow in acceptance: signup, login, me, logout, me-401 sequence passes", "TestRedirectAndCount in acceptance: create, redirect 302, list shows click", "TestSlugConflictAndValidation in acceptance: 409 on dup slug, 400 on ftp", "TestCrossUserDelete in acceptance: other-user delete 404, link still works", "TestStatsThirtyDays in acceptance: 30 days, today count 2", "TestQRCodePNG in acceptance: image/png, valid PNG", "TestRateLimitLogin in acceptance: 11th attempt 429", "TestSPAIndex in acceptance: /app/ and /app/links/abc serve root div", "TestUnknownSlug404 in acceptance: /nope123 returns 404"],
      "size": "medium"
    }
  ]
}
```
